Evidence supports that RBI pre-payment charge/foreclosure penalty directions were withdrawn/repealed (RBI (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 repealed effective 2025-11-28; and the 2014 foreclosure/pre-payment penalty circular withdrawn effective 2026-01-01). Evidence also supports that for floating-rate business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro & Small Enterprises (MSME Act definition) sanctioned/renewed on or after 2026-01-01, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans up to ₹50 lakh.

However, the claim that the applicable rule is the “UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025” is not supported by the provided evidence (no UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions content is shown). Also, the claim does not specify/align with the Tier 3/₹50 lakh condition present in the evidence.
